sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Early detection of pancreatic cancer》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】We discuss studies aimed at finding ways of identifying pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma in high-risk groups, such as among individuals with new-onset diabetes mellitus and people attending primary and secondary care practices with symptoms that suggest this cancer.

evidence.text: We discuss studies aimed at finding ways of identifying pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma in high-risk groups, such as among individuals with new-onset diabetes mellitus and people attending primary and secondary care practices with symptoms that suggest this cancer.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Early detection of pancreatic cancer》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】Here, we review groups at high risk for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, including individuals with inherited predisposition and patients with pancreatic cystic lesions.
